name: Alien Obelisk
description: A dark gray obelisk.  Despite its solid appearance, the face of it seems to slightly ripple, as if it were sand, loosely suspended in space.  The depths of the ripples scream with an eerie, green fluorescence.

names: Place your hand upon the obelisk.
effect.title:
As you approach the massive obelisk,
its surface starts to warp,
and a sound slips free:
like a whisper, beckoning.
A depression quickly forms.
In the shape of your hand.
descriptions: How strange.  It looks like a perfect fit for you.  You have a bad feeling in the pit of your stomach.

name: Alien Obelisk
description: A dark gray obelisk with a massive crack down the middle.

effect.u_message:
The obelisk has broken in your absence.
It stands there.
Staring at you.
Crooked and silent.
